scope: Summed Time Profiler sample weights across target threads; not wall time.

aggregation.self: The first frame in each exported backtrace receives that stack's complete sample count and weight.
aggregation.inclusive_frame: Each distinct binary/name/PC location receives the stack weight once.
aggregation.inclusive_function: Each distinct resolved binary/function receives the stack weight once; recursive frames are deduplicated after symbolication.
aggregation.unknowns: A frame without a known symbol remains identified by its recorded binary and address. Unannotated frames are not assigned to the native image.
aggregation.time: CPU sample weights are summed across threads; inclusive totals overlap and must not be summed as elapsed time.

symbolication.uuid_confirmation: Parent checked dwarfdump UUID against recorded binary 94 before this run.

symbol_artifact_limits.search_scope: Existing target and private run files, plus the Spotlight UUID query. No build, capture, dSYM generation, or object-to-PC inference.
symbol_artifact_limits.source_attribution: The captured release image has no resolved Rust function names. Its native names are DYLD-STUB labels. Unknown PCs are not assigned to source functions.
symbol_artifact_limits.recovery_condition: An exact unstripped image, matching-UUID dSYM, or post-LTO objects with the final link map could supply names. The inspected artifacts provide none of these mappings; other profiling-profile objects and input rlibs do not establish this PC mapping.
